source.notes: Editorially maintained list of official North Carolina resources. Each page was fetched on the retrieval date (HTTP 200) and hashed; quoted text was checked against it. These links are not submission services, appointments, eligibility approvals or price quotes.
source.dropped: USDA NRCS conservation activity pages (national, and the page refused the build host on the retrieval date).

resources.title: Find a county Extension contact
resources.scope: NC State Extension lists a center for each county. A contact-discovery pathway: service availability and individual expertise need confirming with the center.
documents: Write the question you want answered
Describe the site and irrigation source if known
List any existing test report and its date
resources.qualifications: Confirm appointment availability and qualifications with the county center.

resources.title: NCDA&CS routine soil testing
resources.scope: Routine soil fertility testing by the NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Agronomic Division. It is not a general contaminant screen or a crop-safety certificate.
documents: Confirm that fertility is your testing purpose
Read the current sampling and submission instructions on the NCDA&CS page
Record your site label and intended question
resources.qualifications: Contaminant analytes and methods are not established by a fertility test listing.
resources.cost: NCDA&CS states: "Effective March 2, 2026, sample fees for NC Growers will follow this schedule." The amount is not copied here; check the current NC grower fee schedule.
resources.deadline: Current seasonal timing not verified. Check the NCDA&CS page.

resources.title: Certified drinking-water laboratories
resources.matrix: Drinking water; exact analyte and method to confirm
resources.scope: NC DEQ: "Drinking water analyses must be performed by a laboratory certified by the North Carolina State Laboratory of Public Health." A laboratory list is a starting point, not a booking.
documents: Name the water source and the requested analyte
Ask the laboratory to confirm method and certification scope
Obtain the laboratory's containers, handling and delivery instructions
resources.qualifications: NC DEQ notes: "Laboratories are certified to conduct a certain number of tests but may not be certified to conduct every test required of a water system." No laboratory has been selected or verified here.
resources.cost: Quote needed from the selected laboratory.
resources.deadline: Ask about hold time and delivery before collecting.
